T\_1210 is reported as a narrower sensitivity where the processed OECD object has full coverage. GDP is World Bank GDP per capita multiplied by population; per-resident revenue divides cumulative revenue by average population over 2017 to 2022. Spread/CIT uses the spread of cumulative country revenue across the 32 scenarios. Hungary is included as the smaller high-salience country because it has the highest preferred revenue-to-CIT ratio among smaller EU Member States with populated T\_1200 data.
